answer: An adversarial validation market prices admission. Each new identity posts a bond and opens a tradable claim of honesty that anyone may stake against. Every anomaly becomes a thread of evidence: shared funding, duplicated fingerprints, timing collusion sway the odds. When a farm is exposed, losing stakers forfeit collateral, so defending clones burns capital twice - bond plus bad bet. Each exposed cluster enriches the meadow of watchers, and a pulse of skeptical capital waits on registrations: the attacker must out-stake the whole market for every clone, while honest agents keep their bond.
